en: Sao Tome and Principe, officially the Democratic Republic of Sao Tome and Principe, as an island country in the Gulf of Guinea
Its two main islands and its position off the coast of Central Africa
zh: 圣多美和普林西比正式称圣多美和普林西比民主共和国，是几内亚湾岛国
由两个主要岛屿组成，位于中部非洲近海

politics.zh: 圣多美和普林西比民主共和国是几内亚湾岛国，由圣多美与普林西比两个主要岛屿组成，首都为圣多美。它原为葡萄牙殖民地，1975年独立，此后长期由同一政党执政，1990年转向多党制并多次实现政党轮替，是非洲较早建立稳定多党选举的国家之一。
politics.en: Sao Tome and Principe, officially the Democratic Republic of Sao Tome and Principe, is an island country in the Gulf of Guinea made up of the two main islands of Sao Tome and Principe, with the city of Sao Tome as its capital. Formerly a Portuguese colony, it became independent in 1975 and was long governed by a single party before moving to multi-party politics in 1990 and seeing several changes of government, making it one of the earlier African states with stable multi-party elections.

economy.zh: 经济以可可出口、农业、渔业与旅游业以及外国援助为基础，可可长期是主要出口品，海上石油的勘探带来收入预期，岛屿经济规模小且对外依赖明显。
economy.en: The economy rests on cocoa exports, farming, fishing and tourism together with foreign aid, with cocoa long the main export, offshore oil exploration raising revenue expectations, and the island economy small in scale and clearly dependent on outside markets.

culture.zh: 圣多美和普林西比文化融合葡萄牙与非洲传统，克里奥尔语与葡萄牙语并用，音乐与舞蹈如乌苏阿与普伊塔具有特色，天主教与本地信仰并存，种植园建筑留下殖民时期痕迹。
culture.en: The culture of Sao Tome and Principe combines Portuguese and African traditions, Crioulo and Portuguese both being used, its music and dances such as ussua and puita being distinctive, Catholicism existing alongside local beliefs, and plantation buildings preserving traces of the colonial period.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪葡萄牙人的到来与种植园经济的建立、1975年独立、1990年转向多党制，以及此后的多次政党轮替与石油勘探，这些事件塑造了现代圣多美和普林西比。
events.en: Key moments are the arrival of the Portuguese in the fifteenth century and the creation of a plantation economy, independence in 1975, the move to multi-party politics in 1990 and the changes of government and oil exploration since then, events that have shaped modern Sao Tome and Principe.

value.en: It became independent from Portugal in 1975.
It moved to multi-party politics in 1990.

en: The Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt as an ancient Egyptian dynasty of Libyan origin ruling from about 947 to 713 BC
Its rule during the Third Intermediate Period from Bubastis and its control over much of Egypt
zh: 埃及第二十二王朝是公元前947至前713年统治埃及的利比亚出身王朝
属第三中间期，以布巴斯提斯为中心，控制埃及大部分地区

politics.zh: 埃及第二十二王朝是公元前947至前713年统治埃及的利比亚出身王朝，属第三中间期，由沙尚克一世建立，以布巴斯提斯为中心。它通过家族成员分任要职控制各地，一度重新统一埃及并干预黎凡特事务；后期王权衰落，地方势力与第二十三王朝并立，最终被努比亚王朝取代。
politics.en: The Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt was an ancient Egyptian dynasty of Libyan origin that ruled from about 947 to 713 BC during the Third Intermediate Period, founded by Shoshenq I with Bubastis as its centre. It controlled the country through family members appointed to key offices, briefly reunified Egypt and intervened in the Levant; in its later phase royal power declined, local powers and the Twenty-third Dynasty ruling alongside it, until the Nubian dynasty replaced it.

economy.zh: 经济以尼罗河农业、神庙经济与地中海及红海贸易为基础，神庙占有大量土地并参与手工业与贸易，谷物与纺织品是重要产品，地方贵族与神庙分享经济收益。
economy.en: The economy rested on Nile farming, the temple economy and trade with the Mediterranean and the Red Sea, with temples holding large estates and taking part in crafts and trade, grain and textiles among the important products, and local notables and temples sharing the economic returns.

culture.zh: 第二十二王朝留下神庙扩建与王室墓葬遗产，塔尼斯与布巴斯提斯的建筑与金银制品显示其文化取向，利比亚军事传统与埃及宗教制度结合，铭文记录了对黎凡特的远征。
culture.en: The dynasty left a heritage of temple extensions and royal burials, the buildings and gold and silver work of Tanis and Bubastis showing its cultural orientation, Libyan military tradition combining with Egyptian religious institutions, and inscriptions recording expeditions into the Levant.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前947年王朝建立、沙尚克一世对黎凡特的远征、前9世纪后的分裂与第二十三王朝并立，以及前713年前后被努比亚王朝取代，这些事件构成第三中间期的政治格局。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the dynasty around 947 BC, the Levantine campaign of Shoshenq I, the division after the ninth century with the Twenty-third Dynasty ruling alongside it and its replacement by the Nubian dynasty around 713 BC, events that make up the political order of the Third Intermediate Period.

value.zh: 利比亚出身的王朝，以布巴斯提斯为中心。
value.en: It was a dynasty of Libyan origin centred on Bubastis.

value.zh: 前713年前后被努比亚王朝取代。
value.en: It was replaced by the Nubian dynasty around 713 BC.

en: The Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt as an ancient Egyptian dynasty of Libyan origin
Its rule in the Eighth and Upper Egyptian regions alongside the Twenty-second Dynasty
zh: 埃及第二十三王朝是利比亚出身的古代埃及王朝
在下埃及与上埃及部分地区与第二十二王朝并立

politics.zh: 埃及第二十三王朝是利比亚出身的古代埃及王朝，约公元前837年起在底比斯与上埃及一带与第二十二王朝并立，统治者多出自同一利比亚家族的分支。它控制上埃及的神庙与地方行政，与第二十二王朝及地方势力频繁争夺；前8世纪后期在努比亚王朝的扩张下失去独立地位，埃及随后由努比亚王朝统一。
politics.en: The Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt was an ancient Egyptian dynasty of Libyan origin that ruled from about 837 BC in Thebes and parts of Upper Egypt alongside the Twenty-second Dynasty, its rulers mostly belonging to branches of the same Libyan family. It controlled the temples and local administration of Upper Egypt and competed frequently with the Twenty-second Dynasty and local powers; in the later eighth century it lost its independence to the expanding Nubian dynasty, which then reunified Egypt.

economy.zh: 经济以尼罗河上游的农业、神庙经济与努比亚方向的贸易为基础，底比斯的神庙占有大量土地与资源，黄金与香料贸易经由南方商路，地方统治者依靠神庙收入维持权力。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in Upper Egypt, the temple economy and trade towards Nubia, with the temples of Thebes holding large estates and resources, gold and incense moving along southern routes, and local rulers relying on temple revenue to maintain power.

culture.zh: 第二十三王朝时期底比斯的宗教与建筑持续发展，阿蒙神庙的扩建与铭文留下遗存，利比亚军事精英与埃及祭司集团结合，王权观念与地方神权相互影响。
culture.en: In the period of the Twenty-third Dynasty religion and building continued at Thebes, extensions to the temple of Amun and inscriptions surviving as remains, the Libyan military elite combining with the Egyptian priesthood, and royal ideology and local religious authority influencing each other.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前837年王朝的建立、与第二十二王朝的长期争夺、前8世纪努比亚势力的北上，以及此后埃及由努比亚王朝统一，这些事件结束了利比亚诸王朝的分立局面。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the dynasty around 837 BC, its long contest with the Twenty-second Dynasty, the northward advance of Nubian power in the eighth century and the later reunification of Egypt under the Nubian dynasty, events that ended the division among the Libyan dynasties.

value.zh: 利比亚出身的王朝，与第二十二王朝并立。
value.en: It was a dynasty of Libyan origin ruling alongside the Twenty-second Dynasty.

value.zh: 前8世纪后期被努比亚王朝取代。
value.en: It lost its independence to the Nubian dynasty in the later eighth century.

en: Guinea, officially the Republic of Guinea, as a coastal country in West Africa
Its borders with Guinea-Bissau, Senegal, Mali, Ivory Coast, Liberia and Sierra Leone
zh: 几内亚正式称几内亚共和国，是西非沿海国家
邻几内亚比绍、塞内加尔、马里、科特迪瓦、利比里亚与塞拉利昂

politics.zh: 几内亚共和国是西非沿海国家，邻几内亚比绍、塞内加尔、马里、科特迪瓦、利比里亚与塞拉利昂，首都为科纳克里。它1958年通过公投拒绝加入法兰西共同体并独立，此后长期由军人执政与威权统治，1990年代引入多党制，2021年再度发生政变，政治过渡仍在进行。
politics.en: Guinea, officially the Republic of Guinea, is a coastal country in West Africa bordered by Guinea-Bissau, Senegal, Mali, Ivory Coast, Liberia and Sierra Leone, with Conakry as its capital. In 1958 it voted in a referendum to reject membership of the French Community and became independent, after which it was long governed by military and authoritarian rule; multi-party politics was introduced in the 1990s and a further coup took place in 2021, with the political transition still under way.

economy.zh: 经济以铝土矿开采、黄金、农业与水力发电为基础，铝土矿储量居世界前列，矿业出口是主要财源，农业以稻米与热带作物为主，基础设施与电力供应仍是发展瓶颈。
economy.en: The economy rests on bauxite mining, gold, farming and hydropower, with bauxite reserves among the largest in the world, mining exports the main source of revenue, rice and tropical crops the leading farm products, and infrastructure and electricity supply still bottlenecks for development.

culture.zh: 几内亚有富拉、马林凯、苏苏等族群，法语为官方语言而各族语言广泛使用，音乐传统著名，科拉琴与非洲巴拉风演奏影响西非乃至世界音乐，伊斯兰教影响深厚。
culture.en: Guinea is made up of Fula, Malinke and Susu communities among others, French is official while the various national languages are widely spoken, its musical tradition is famous, the kora and balafon having influenced West African and world music, and Islam is deeply influential.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1958年拒绝加入法兰西共同体并独立、1984年政变、1990年代的多党制，以及2021年政变与随后的政治过渡，这些事件决定了现代几内亚的政治进程。
events.en: Key moments are the rejection of the French Community and independence in 1958, the coup of 1984, the multi-party politics of the 1990s and the coup of 2021 with the political transition that followed, events that have determined the political course of modern Guinea.

value.zh: 1958年公投拒绝加入法兰西共同体并独立。
value.en: In 1958 it voted to reject the French Community and became independent.

en: The Zand dynasty as an Iranian dynasty that ruled from 1751 to 1794
Its rule by Karim Khan from Shiraz and its replacement by the Qajars
zh: 赞德王朝是1751至1794年统治伊朗的王朝
由卡里姆汗以设拉子为中心统治，后被卡扎尔王朝取代

politics.zh: 赞德王朝是1751至1794年统治伊朗的王朝，由卡里姆汗在纳迪尔沙死后建立，以设拉子为都，控制伊朗中部与南部。他自称人民的代理人而非国王，重建城市与贸易、相对宽待宗教少数群体；1794年其继承者被卡扎尔王朝的阿迦·穆罕默德汗击败，赞德王朝结束。
politics.en: The Zand dynasty was an Iranian dynasty that ruled from 1751 to 1794, established by Karim Khan after the death of Nader Shah with Shiraz as its capital, controlling central and southern Iran. He styled himself the people's deputy rather than king, rebuilt cities and trade and treated religious minorities with relative tolerance; in 1794 his successors were defeated by Agha Mohammad Khan of the Qajar dynasty and Zand rule came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以伊朗中南部农业、手工业与波斯湾贸易为基础，设拉子与布什尔是商业中心，卡里姆汗重建灌溉与市集，贸易与关税收入支撑财政，海湾贸易在其治下活跃。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in central and southern Iran, crafts and Persian Gulf trade, with Shiraz and Bushehr as centres of commerce, Karim Khan rebuilding irrigation and bazaars, trade and customs revenue supporting public finances, and Gulf commerce active under his rule.

culture.zh: 赞德时期设拉子的建筑与园林得到发展，宫廷赞助诗歌与艺术，波斯文学传统延续，与欧洲使节的往来见于记载，城市修复工程留下至今可见的遗产。
culture.en: In the Zand period the buildings and gardens of Shiraz were developed, the court patronising poetry and art, Persian literary tradition continuing, exchanges with European envoys being recorded, and urban restoration works leaving a legacy still visible today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1751年卡里姆汗掌权、设拉子建设的兴盛、1779年卡里姆汗去世后的内争，以及1794年被卡扎尔王朝击败，这些事件决定了18世纪后期伊朗的政治走向。
events.en: Key moments are the accession of Karim Khan in 1751, the flourishing of building at Shiraz, the internal struggles after his death in 1779 and the defeat by the Qajar dynasty in 1794, events that determined the political direction of later eighteenth-century Iran.

value.en: It was defeated by the Qajar dynasty in 1794.

en: The Greco-Bactrian Kingdom as a Hellenistic state in Bactria and Sogdiana
Its rule from the third to the second century BC and its expansion into north-western India
zh: 大夏又称希腊-巴克特里亚王国，是巴克特里亚与粟特的希腊化国家
公元前3至前2世纪存在，并扩展到印度西北部

politics.zh: 大夏又称希腊-巴克特里亚王国，是巴克特里亚与粟特的希腊化国家，约公元前250年由狄奥多托斯一世脱离塞琉古帝国独立，以巴克特拉（今巴尔赫）为中心。它在欧西德莫斯与德米特里等君主时期扩展至印度西北部，与塞琉古、帕提亚及印度诸势力互动；约前2世纪中叶在斯基泰与月氏等游牧族群的压力下瓦解。
politics.en: The Greco-Bactrian Kingdom was a Hellenistic state in Bactria and Sogdiana that became independent from the Seleucid empire around 250 BC under Diodotus I, with Bactra, modern Balkh, as its centre. Under rulers such as Euthydemus and Demetrius it expanded into north-western India and interacted with the Seleucids, the Parthians and Indian powers; in about the middle of the second century BC it broke up under pressure from Scythian and Yuezhi nomadic groups.

economy.zh: 经济以巴克特里亚与粟特的绿洲农业、手工业与丝路贸易为基础，巴克特拉与阿伊哈努姆等城市是商业与行政中心，银币铸造规模大，商队贸易连接中国、印度与地中海世界。
economy.en: The economy rested on oasis farming and crafts in Bactria and Sogdiana and on Silk Road trade, with cities such as Bactra and Ai-Khanoum serving as centres of commerce and administration, silver coinage struck on a large scale, and caravan trade linking China, India and the Mediterranean world.

culture.zh: 大夏是希腊文化与中亚传统交融的典型，阿伊哈努姆遗址出土希腊式剧场与铭文，佛教与希腊化艺术在此接触并影响犍陀罗艺术，钱币上希腊文与本地文字并用。
culture.en: The kingdom was a classic meeting of Greek culture and Central Asian tradition, the site of Ai-Khanoum yielding a Greek theatre and inscriptions, Buddhism and Hellenistic art coming into contact there and influencing Gandharan art, and its coins carrying Greek and local scripts side by side.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前250年脱离塞琉古独立、前3世纪末与塞琉古的战争、前2世纪向印度西北的扩张，以及前2世纪中叶在游牧族群压力下瓦解，这些事件改变了中亚的政治与文化格局。
events.en: Key moments are independence from the Seleucids around 250 BC, the war with the Seleucids at the end of the third century, expansion into north-western India in the second century and the break-up under nomadic pressure in the middle of that century, events that changed the political and cultural order of Central Asia.

value.zh: 约公元前250年脱离塞琉古帝国独立。
value.en: It became independent from the Seleucid empire around 250 BC.

value.zh: 以巴克特拉（今巴尔赫）为中心。
value.en: It was centred on Bactra, modern Balkh.

en: The Alid dynasties of northern Iran, also called the Alavids, as Zaydi Shia states in Tabaristan and Daylam
Their rule in the ninth and tenth centuries and their role in spreading Shia Islam in the Caspian region
zh: 阿拉菲德王朝又称阿拉维王朝，是塔巴里斯坦与迪拉姆的宰德派什叶派政权
9至10世纪统治，推动什叶派伊斯兰教在里海地区传播

politics.zh: 阿拉菲德王朝又称阿拉维王朝，是塔巴里斯坦与迪拉姆的宰德派什叶派政权，9世纪由来自麦地那的哈桑后裔在里海南岸山地建立，得到当地迪拉姆与塔巴里斯坦居民支持。它以宰德派教义为基础，与阿拔斯王朝、萨曼王朝及布益王朝互动；10世纪后期被萨曼与布益势力取代，但其宗教传统延续。
politics.en: The Alid dynasties of northern Iran, also called the Alavids, were Zaydi Shia states in Tabaristan and Daylam established in the ninth century by Hasanid descendants from Medina in the mountains south of the Caspian, with the support of the local Daylamite and Tabaristani population. Based on Zaydi doctrine, they interacted with the Abbasids, the Samanids and the Buyids; in the later tenth century they were displaced by Samanid and Buyid power, though their religious tradition continued.

economy.zh: 经济以里海南岸山地的农业、畜牧、丝绸与木材生产以及山地贸易为基础，迪拉姆山区出产木材与丝织品，与吉兰、塔巴里斯坦的平原市镇交换粮食与手工业品。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding in the mountains south of the Caspian, silk and timber production and mountain trade, with the Daylam highlands supplying timber and silk goods and exchanging them for grain and crafts from the towns of Gilan and Tabaristan.

culture.zh: 阿拉菲德时期什叶派学术与地方文化发展，宰德派教法著作与圣训传统在此流传，波斯语与阿拉伯语并用，山地社会结构与宗教权威结合，为后来布益王朝的兴起提供基础。
culture.en: In the Alid period Shia scholarship and local culture developed, Zaydi legal works and hadith tradition circulating there, Persian and Arabic both in use, mountain social structures combining with religious authority, and a basis being laid for the later rise of the Buyids.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪阿拉菲德政权的建立、与阿拔斯及萨曼王朝的战争、10世纪内部分裂与布益势力的兴起，以及此后该地区宗教传统的延续，这些事件塑造了里海地区的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of Alid rule in the ninth century, the wars with the Abbasids and Samanids, the internal divisions of the tenth century and the rise of Buyid power, and the later continuation of the region's religious tradition, events that shaped the history of the Caspian region.

value.zh: 由来自麦地那的哈桑后裔建立。
value.en: It was founded by Hasanid descendants from Medina.

value.zh: 以宰德派什叶派教义为基础。
value.en: It was based on Zaydi Shia doctrine.

en: The Pahlavi dynasty as the Iranian royal dynasty that ruled from 1925 to 1979
Its modernisation programme and its overthrow in the Iranian revolution
zh: 巴列维王朝是1925至1979年统治伊朗的王朝
推行现代化改革，在伊朗革命中被推翻

politics.zh: 巴列维王朝是1925至1979年统治伊朗的王朝，由礼萨汗在推翻卡扎尔王朝后建立，1941年其子穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维继位。它推行中央集权、世俗化与工业化改革，依靠石油收入扩军并与西方结盟，1953年政变后加强威权统治；1979年伊斯兰革命推翻君主制，王朝终结。
politics.en: The Pahlavi dynasty was the Iranian royal dynasty that ruled from 1925 to 1979, founded by Reza Shah after the overthrow of the Qajars, whose son Mohammad Reza Pahlavi succeeded in 1941. It carried out centralising, secularising and industrialising reforms, used oil revenue to expand the army and allied itself with the West, and became more authoritarian after the coup of 1953; in 1979 the Islamic revolution overthrew the monarchy and the dynasty came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以石油收入、工业化与基础设施建设为基础，石油在1950年代国有化后成为财政核心，制造业与城市化发展迅速，土地改革与白色革命改变了乡村结构，同时贫富与城乡差距扩大。
economy.en: The economy rested on oil revenue, industrialisation and infrastructure building, with oil becoming the core of public finances after nationalisation in the 1950s, manufacturing and urbanisation growing quickly, and land reform and the White Revolution changing rural structures while differences of wealth and between town and country widened.

culture.zh: 巴列维时期推行世俗教育与文化现代化，德黑兰大学与博物馆体系扩展，考古与波斯文化遗产受到重视，电影与文学发展，同时宗教与传统社群的反弹日益明显。
culture.en: In the Pahlavi period secular education and cultural modernisation were promoted, the University of Tehran and the museum system expanded, archaeology and Persian cultural heritage received attention, cinema and literature developed, and at the same time the reaction of religious and traditional communities became increasingly visible.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1925年礼萨汗建立王朝、1941年其子继位、1951至1953年的石油国有化与政变、1963年的白色革命，以及1979年伊斯兰革命推翻君主制，这些事件塑造了现代伊朗。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the dynasty by Reza Shah in 1925, the succession of his son in 1941, the oil nationalisation and coup of 1951 to 1953, the White Revolution of 1963 and the Islamic revolution that overthrew the monarchy in 1979, events that have shaped modern Iran.

value.en: It was founded by Reza Shah in 1925.
The Islamic revolution overthrew the monarchy in 1979.
